title: Pilot changelog workflow smoke test
summary: Added the Moss pilot changelog workflow, agent instructions, and a small documentation note so the tracked changelog publish path can be exercised end to end.
highlights: Added shared AI runtime and agent instruction files so local agents know how to draft tracked Moonrise changelogs for Moss.
Added tracked changelog config, tracked latest changelog file, and a publish-only GitHub Actions workflow backed by the Moonrise publish helper script.
Documented that a tiny docs-only change is enough for pilot smoke tests when the changelog clearly explains what was tested.

source.notes: Smoke-test changelog generated locally after landing the Moss pilot files.
